title: Looker Instances Expose AuthType Details
summary: The Looker API now provides more granular details about authentication configurations for instances. Developers can inspect whether Google Auth or Workforce Identity Federation is enabled.
details: A new `authType` field has been added to the `Instance` schema. This optional field references a newly introduced `AuthType` schema, which contains boolean properties `googleAuthEnabled` and `workforceAuthEnabled`. This enhancement allows developers to programmatically determine the authentication methods configured for their Looker instances, offering better visibility into security and access settings.
